title: Census 2027 to Include 40 Questions on Caste and Aadhaar

blocks.content: The Union Government of India notified 40 questions for the Population Enumeration phase of Census 2027 on 14 August 2026. The schedule includes demographic, educational, and socio-economic particulars under the Household Schedule, and it also asks for identification details such as Aadhaar number, voter ID, driving licence, and passport number where applicable.

items: The Census of India is conducted under the Census Act, 1948.
The Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India is the statutory authority for census operations.
The 2027 census is described as India’s first digital census.
Question 10 includes “Scheduled Caste (SC)/Scheduled Tribe (ST)/Caste” as an open-ended field.
